title: ManageSieve RFC 5804: per-user Sieve script management
description: Expose per-user Sieve script management via ManageSieve protocol (RFC 5804) on port 4190. ManageSieve is the standard protocol — Thunderbird, Roundcube, and most IMAP clients support it natively via a plugin or built-in. Commands to implement: CAPABILITY, AUTHENTICATE (PLAIN over TLS, SCRAM-SHA-256), STARTTLS, LISTSCRIPTS, PUTSCRIPT (upload + parse-validate, return parse errors with line/col), GETSCRIPT, DELETESCRIPT, SETACTIVE, RENAMESCRIPT, CHECKSCRIPT (validate without storing), LOGOUT, NOOP, HAVESPACE. Script size limit: configurable, default 64 KB. STARTTLS required before AUTHENTICATE (reject plaintext auth). If ManageSieve proves too complex for v1, fall back to HTTP admin endpoints (PUT /admin/sieve/{username}/{scriptname}, GET, DELETE, POST .../activate) consistent with the existing admin pattern — note this in the epic and decide at implementation time. Either way: validate script (parse-check) before saving, return parse errors. Store compiled AST alongside raw bytes in user_sieve_scripts table.
